name: Banking Blocks for WooCommerce
author: LokusWP

sections.description:
Banking Blocks for WooCommerce is a plugin that allows you to effortlessly integrate various bank payment methods into your WooCommerce store using the block-based editor.
This plugin is ideal for store owners looking to expand their payment options while leveraging the intuitive capabilities of the Gutenberg editor.

Key Features:
– Multiple Bank Payment Methods: Easily add and configure a variety of bank payment options tailored to your localers’ needs.
– Checkout Block Integration: Utilize the block editor to place bank payment options directly within your product pages or checkout process.
– User-Friendly Experience: Designed for both developers and store owners, making it easy to manage and implement payment solutions.

How to Use

  1. Install the Plugin: Download and install the Banking Blocks for WooCommerce plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the Plugin: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure Payment Methods: Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments to configure your desired bank payment methods.
  4. Add Payment Blocks: Use the Gutenberg editor to insert Banking Blocks for bank payment methods into your checkout or product pages.
  5. Test Your Setup: Conduct test transactions to ensure the payment methods are functioning correctly.

If you have ideas or suggestions about features we should add, feel free to rate the plugin and ask questions in the support forum.

For support with this plugin, please visit the Support Forums.
